## reference · Google AI Overviews and SEO 2026
* Google AI Overviews appear for 47-64% of all search queries in 2026, up from 25-30% in 2024.
* Ranking #1 no longer guarantees clicks, with a 30-50% average CTR drop for top positions in queries with AI Overviews.
* Being cited inside an AI Overview drives higher trust perception, increased branded search volume, and higher conversion rates.
* Winning strategies include:
  + Structured data optimization
  + Entity authority building
  + Citation-worthy content creation
  + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) approach
* AI Overview-referred visitors arrive with more context and higher intent, delivering better conversion rates for adapted sites.
* Non-adapted sites may see 20-40% traffic declines for informational queries.
* AI Overviews are more common in certain verticals, such as health, finance, technology, and education, reaching 70% or more of informational queries.
* Optimizing for AI Overviews requires integrating disciplines like GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI SEO into a cohesive strategy.
